title: Extraction of Total Nucleic Acid from Wastewater Using the Promega Wizard Enviro Kit
author: Tamara Walsky
materials: Promega Wizard Enviro Total Nucleic Acid Kit

steps.title: Collect wastewater sample
steps.instruction: Dispense 40 mL of raw or pasteurized wastewater into a 50 mL conical screw‑cap tube. If pasteurizing, incubate at 60 °C for 1 h; follow institutional biosafety guidelines.

steps.title: Add protease and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Protease Solution, mix by gentle inversion, and incubate at room temperature for 30 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge to remove solids
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 3 000 × g, room temperature, for 10 min to pellet solids.

steps.title: Decant clarified supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully decant 20 mL of the supernatant into each of two clean 50 mL conical screw‑cap tubes; discard the pellet in a biohazard container. If a loose pellet forms, allow it to settle again or use a serological pipet to avoid transferring solids.

steps.title: Add binding buffers
steps.instruction: To each tube containing 20 mL supernatant, add 6 mL Binding Buffer 1 (BBD) followed by 500 µL Binding Buffer 2 (BBE). Mix by gentle inversion 10 times (or until thoroughly mixed).

steps.title: Add isopropanol and mix
steps.instruction: Add 24 mL isopropanol to each tube and mix by gentle inversion 10 times (or until thoroughly mixed).

steps.title: Set up vacuum manifold
steps.instruction: Remove the vacuum‑port cap, attach a Reservoir Extension Funnel to a PureYield™ Binding Column, and connect the column to the Vac‑Man® vacuum manifold by pressing the nozzle into the port. The funnel allows up to 100 mL of sample mixture per column; process 6–8 samples per manifold.

steps.title: Load sample onto column
steps.instruction: Pour the entire mixture from each tube into the Reservoir Extension Funnel on the PureYield™ Binding Column (combine both tubes of the same sample if applicable). Turn on the pump and apply vacuum to capture total nucleic acid (TNA) on the column. Periodically empty the blue Vac‑Man® waste container.

steps.title: Wash column with CWE
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL Column Wash 1 (CWE) to the column and apply vacuum. Ensure that 57 mL isopropanol has been pre‑added to the CWE bottle.

steps.title: Wash column with RWA
steps.instruction: Add 20 mL Column Wash 2 (RWA) to the column and apply vacuum. After all visible liquid has passed, continue vacuum for an additional 30 s. Ensure that 350 mL 95 % (v/v) ethanol has been pre‑added to the RWA bottle.

steps.title: Preheat elution water
steps.instruction: Preheat 1.2 mL nuclease‑free water per sample to 60 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Assemble elution device
steps.instruction: Place a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube into the base of the Eluator™ Vacuum Elution Device (cap locked open). Insert the PureYield™ Binding Column into the top of the device, ensuring it is fully seated.

steps.title: Elute TNA from column
steps.instruction: Place the assembled Eluator™ device onto the vacuum manifold. Add 500 µL pre‑heated (60 °C) nuclease‑free water to the column, apply maximum vacuum for 1 min or until all liquid passes. Repeat with another 500 µL pre‑heated water to elute a total of 1 mL TNA solution.

steps.title: Add binding buffers to eluate
steps.instruction: To the 1 mL eluate, add 400 µL Binding Buffer 1 (BBD) and 100 µL Binding Buffer 2 (BBE). Mix by gentle inversion 10 times (or until thoroughly mixed). Divide the mixture into two DNA LoBind 1.5 mL tubes, 750 µL each.

steps.title: Add isopropanol to tubes
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL isopropanol to each tube and mix by gentle inversion 10 times (or until thoroughly mixed).

steps.title: Bind nucleic acid to minicolumn
steps.instruction: Place a PureYield™ Minicolumn into a PureYield™ Collection Tube. Transfer the entire volume through the minicolumn, loading 750 µL at a time (four loads total) using a microcentrifuge at 10 000 rpm, room temperature, for 1 min per spin.

steps.title: Wash minicolumn with CWE
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL Column Wash 1 (CWE) to the minicolumn and centrifuge at 10 000 rpm, room temperature, for 1 min. Discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash minicolumn with RWA
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Column Wash 2 (RWA) to the minicolumn and centrifuge at 10 000 rpm, room temperature, for 1 min. Repeat this wash once more. Discard the flow‑through after each spin.

steps.title: Remove residual wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the minicolumn at 10 000 rpm, room temperature, for 30 s to remove any residual wash solution.

steps.title: Preheat final elution water
steps.instruction: Preheat 65 µL nuclease‑free water per sample to 60 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Elute nucleic acid from minicolumn
steps.instruction: Transfer the minicolumn to a new DNA LoBind 1.5 mL tube, add 30 µL pre‑heated water, and let soak for ~1 min. Centrifuge at 10 000 rpm, room temperature, for 1 min to elute. Repeat with another 30 µL pre‑heated water for a total eluate volume of 60 µL.

steps.title: Store purified TNA
steps.instruction: Store the purified total nucleic acid at ≤ ‑20 °C until further analysis (e.g., RT‑qPCR).
